sections.Aims and Fit of Module: This module is designed to: Provide a comprehensive grounding in the techniques used by the production department when undertaking the production of a short film Introduce students to the production processes and paperwork used in the management of a short production
sections.Learning outcomes: A Understand the creative role of a producer in a short film, whether documentary or fiction B Anticipate and react to production challenges in order to effectively contribute as part of a production department C Apply the theoretical knowledge gained during the course to create production paperwork
sections.Method of teaching and learning: The teaching sessions are divided into two components (Lectures and seminars). A series of lectures will equip the students with the knowledge and understanding of production and the production processes. Seminars will focus on case study work and production management.
